product.toshiba-t3200.creation.fact1: 1 MB base / 4 MB card in EMS-only or 3 MB extended mode
product.toshiba-t3200.summary: Original 12 MHz 286 portable with EGA-compatible graphics and a plasma panel.
product.toshiba-t3200.history: The original T3200 combines a 12 MHz 80286, plasma display and two expansion slots in a transportable computer. Toshiba marketed it as a compact desktop alternative. Its brochure lists 1 MB RAM, a 40 MB hard disk, a 720 KB floppy drive and MS-DOS 3.2. TECHaccess documents later 1.44 MB drives and an upgrade to that capacity; the production date and serial boundary remain unknown. The T3200SX has different hardware and a separate entry.
product.toshiba-t3200.technical.market: A transportable business PC positioned as a compact desktop alternative, combining an integrated plasma display with room for standard expansion cards.
product.toshiba-t3200.technical.commerci: The Toshiba brochure lists a 12 MHz 80286, 1 MB RAM, a 40 MB hard disk, a 720 KB floppy drive and MS-DOS 3.2. Toshiba later documented original T3200 units with a 1.44 MB drive and an upgrade option; the revision boundary is unknown.
product.toshiba-t3200.technical.accessor: Documented expansion includes the optional 3 MB memory card, an 80287 coprocessor, external RGB display support and two internal expansion slots.
product.toshiba-t3200.warning: EXPERIMENTAL: BIOS 4.61 and Toshiba DOS 3.30 boot with both internal floppy choices. The two 4 MB memory endpoints, complete floppy formats, MFM installation and BIOS-mediated display switching have been validated. PEGA2 timing, AGS capture/NMI and physical memory-card decode remain approximate.
product.toshiba-t3200.technical.memory: 1 MB: 640 KB conventional + 384 KB EMS. With the optional 3 MB card, EMS-only mode provides 3456 KB EMS; extended mode provides 3072 KB extended + 384 KB EMS. Both endpoints pass Toshiba EMM.SYS and write/read tests. Physical EMS page order is approximated; intermediate 0.5–2.5 MB splits and 512 KB conventional mode remain unavailable.
product.toshiba-t3200.technical.video: Experimental 256 KB EGA with separate 2 KB AGS SRAM. Internal plasma decodes four BIOS/XCHAD levels; external output retains the sixteen EGA colors. Right Ctrl + Home/End selects the display. Right Ctrl + Down requests the BIOS 350/400-line extension. Documented 640-column active modes retain physical pixel proportions; exact line replication, fonts, hue and full-panel placement remain approximate. The resident XCHAD Ctrl+SysReq menu opens, edits levels and retains them on reopening; 41h SRAM access is supported. Capture/NMI and broader PEGA2 behavior remain incomplete.
product.toshiba-t3200.technical.storage: One internal 3.5-inch floppy: early 720 KB or later 1.44 MB. Unmodified BIOS 4.61 identifies the drive selected in Configure. Experimental internal MFM for Fujitsu M2227DT, physical 615/8/17; BIOS type 4 uses 612/8/17. New profiles contain no hard disk.
product.toshiba-t3200.technical.firmware: Toshiba system BIOS 4.61: IC22_033E.BIN and IC24_034E.BIN, 32 KB each; AGS_IC8_035C.BIN, 32 KB. Local ROMs required; hashes and provenance in the machine documentation.
product.toshiba-t3200.technical.validati: Both 720 KB and 1.44 MB pass complete BIOS format/read, DOS FORMAT /S and fresh-process boot. A new MFM disk passes all BIOS-visible sectors, native FDISK and FORMAT /S, installation of all 67 Toshiba DOS 3.30 utilities, independent hard-disk boot and CHKDSK. Both 4 MB memory endpoints pass Toshiba SETUP, EMM.SYS and full page tests. FDC channel-2 DMA into the D000 EMS window also passes. These are scoped functional results, not cycle accuracy.
product.toshiba-t3200.creation.note: Default: one 1.44 MB A: drive with BIOS 4.61; 720 KB is also selectable. Configure retains the same drive choice. External drives and A/B switching are not modeled. Local ROMs are required; DOS and hard disks are not distributed. First boot may request F1 for CMOS setup. The 4 MB choices provide either 3456 KB EMS or 3072 KB extended + 384 KB EMS; the latter also requires selecting 3 MB extended in Toshiba SETUP. Both endpoints are validated. Physical EMS page order is approximated; intermediate splits and 512 KB conventional mode remain unavailable.
product.toshiba-t3200.technical.manual: Toshiba T3200 maintenance manual; original model hardware and custom-logic appendices.
product.toshiba-t3200.technical.brochure: Two-page Toshiba T3200 brochure: 720 KB configuration with MS-DOS 3.2; publication date unidentified.
product.toshiba-t3200.technical.techacce: TECHaccess: early 720 KB T3200, later 1.44 MB drives and an upgrade option. The revision boundary is unspecified.
